verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only web-portal interactions for the Guichet unique filing service: dashboards, online filing of deeds, FranceConnect+ login, and qualified e-signature. None of it documents a public API for creating, submitting, or tracking formalities programmatically. The keyless JSON endpoint seen in the probe belongs to the separate recherche-entreprises company-data API, not the Guichet unique, so it earns no credit here.
